# DropSpace v0.3.0-beta.26 — Release candidate quality fixes

<!-- update-summary: Beta 26 fixes real lyric-provider failures, media artwork and timeline races, virtual-file COM crashes and duplicate names, source-safe payload cleanup, ZIP folder preservation, update recovery, and stale-artifact release validation. -->

## Changes

- Restore lyrics with unknown duration through LRCLIB search; correct Kugou duration units and retain verified album identity. Keep NetEase first, strict candidate identity, bounded fallback, and offline Local LRC.
- Isolate artwork failures from current-track metadata, detach disappeared media sessions, align playback capabilities with current playback state, and preserve estimated timeline continuity.
- Fix Apple Music pause/resume progress jumps and metadata starvation during frequent timeline updates; retain preferred-session recovery events. Align translations once with their sung line instead of repeating them on zero-time credits.
- Fix virtual-file COM unmarshalling, duplicate-name reservations and failure cleanup; prevent linked payload paths from touching external source files and allow cleanup retries to progress past blocked entries.
- Preserve ZIP folder hierarchy and empty directories with bounded enumeration.
- Restore retryable update state when installation is cancelled before launch; reject malformed pending state and release artifacts with mismatched embedded versions.
- Initialize the Windows App SDK in the native test host. Upgrade lifecycle validation now uses the actual historical installer, rather than relabelling a current payload.

## Upgrade compatibility

Beta 25 to Beta 26 keeps the Beta channel, SQLite/settings schema and existing local data. `RELEASE_VERSION` derives file/package version `0.3.0.26`. Historical releases remain immutable. Unsigned Beta retains manual-install trust boundaries.

## Validation boundary

See [the Beta 26 audit](https://github.com/airanluo-dot/DropSpace/blob/main/docs/dev/beta26-rc-audit.md) for executed tests, actual Apple Music/NetEase evidence and explicit NOT VERIFIED target-machine items. Minimum: x64 Windows build 20348.
